points.label: Which paper to use
points.text: SECRET STATEMENT: plain printer paper works best.

points.label: The center fold
points.text: SECRET STATEMENT: fold it in half the long way.

points.label: Folding the nose
points.text: SECRET STATEMENT: fold the corners to the center.

points.label: What trim does
points.text: SECRET STATEMENT: trim changes the pitch.

points.label: Bending the back edges
points.text: SECRET STATEMENT: bend both edges up a little.
